prompt_en:
Fix this sliding-window function and return the complete corrected function. It must return the length of the longest substring without repeated characters:

def longest_unique(text):
    seen = set()
    left = 0
    best = 0
    for right, char in enumerate(text):
        if char in seen:
            seen.remove(text[left])
            left += 1
        seen.add(char)
        best = max(best, right - left + 1)
    return best
prompt_sw:
Rekebisha kitendakazi hiki cha dirisha linalosogea na urejeshe kitendakazi kizima kilichosahihishwa. Lazima kirejeshe urefu wa mfuatano mdogo mrefu zaidi usio na herufi inayojirudia:

def longest_unique(text):
    seen = set()
    left = 0
    best = 0
    for right, char in enumerate(text):
        if char in seen:
            seen.remove(text[left])
            left += 1
        seen.add(char)
        best = max(best, right - left + 1)
    return best
prompt_af:
Maak hierdie glyvensterfunksie reg en gee die volledige gekorrigeerde funksie terug. Dit moet die lengte van die langste substring sonder herhaalde karakters teruggee:

def longest_unique(text):
    seen = set()
    left = 0
    best = 0
    for right, char in enumerate(text):
        if char in seen:
            seen.remove(text[left])
            left += 1
        seen.add(char)
        best = max(best, right - left + 1)
    return best
